hypotheses.statement: The Service checkout selector includes both app=checkout and track=label-2768a42373, while the associated EndpointSlice endpointslice-9ac1e92127 shows an empty endpoints list, indicating no endpoints matched this selector at observation time. This observation is consistent with the service-selection hypothesis because the track label may not be present on any running Pods, causing the Service to select zero endpoints and resulting in connection refusal for clients.

The empty EndpointSlice endpoints list could also be consistent with application-regression if Pods matching the selector exist but are not Ready (e.g., crashing due to a regression), since EndpointSlice only includes Ready Pods. However, no Pod, ReplicaSet, or Deployment observations were acquired to confirm whether matching Pods exist but are unready, so this hypothesis remains plausible but unverified by the current evidence.
